Players (excluding Ultimate Ironmen) can sell the [[cape pouch]], [[Funky shaped log|funky-shaped log]], and [[Log basket#Closed|log basket]] back to the shop for 80% of their cost; this includes a refund of both anima bark and logs. Players may also sell duplicate [[pheasant tail feathers]], [[sturdy beehive parts]], [[golden pheasant egg]]s, [[petal garland]]s, and [[fox whistle]]s. [[Ultimate Ironman|Ultimate ironmen]] can make use of a log storage option at the [[Friendly Forester]] that will permanently store logs exclusively for use in the Forestry Shop, i.e., they may not be withdrawn once deposited. Logs deposited in this manner can be used to substitute noted logs in the Forestry Shop. {{Bug|The Forestry Shop states that both the Forestry and Lumberjack tops and legs provide 0.4% and 0.2% experience boosts, respectively; this is false, as the top provides 0.8% and the legs 0.6%.}} ==Stock== {{StoreTableHead|currency=Anima-infused bark|hidestock=no|hiderestock=y|hidege=y|hidecaption=y|column1=Logs required|column2=Materials needed to craft|column3=Skill requirements|column4=Members|shopversion=(1),(2),(3),(4)}} {{StoreLine|name=Forestry kit|displayname=Forestry kit|sell=0|buy=N/A|stock=inf|gemw=no|column1=None|column2=None|column3=None|column4={{Members|no}}|restock=}} {{StoreLine|name=Secateurs blade|sell=20|buy=N/A|stock=inf|gemw=no|column1={{plinkp|Oak logs}} 10 [[Oak logs]] (noted)
